persons.name: Kitamānsiṃha
persons.evidence: dānapate jajomāna nepāramaṇḍare asaṃtore cibāhānani gṛhevāsthita tulādhraṃ jajomāna kitamānsiṃhayā dharmacitta utpati juyāo thva gātilā yāyagu kaṇṭha coyāo tayā jula

date.as_written: śubha samvat 1034 sālamti bhādra kṛṣṇayā caturdaśiṣunu

notes: Kitamānsiṃha is a vernacular form of Kīrtimānsiṃha, of the Tulādhara caste residing in Asan, Ciba Bahal Nani, Kathmandu.
